title.narrative: Strengthening social cohesion and resilience in conflict affected communities of Plateau State.

description.narrative: The proposed project, "Strengthening Social Cohesion and Resilience in Conflict-Affected Communities of Plateau State" aims to address the profound socio-political and economic challenges exacerbated by recurring conflicts in the project target locations. Plateau State, Nigeria, has been deeply scarred by violent conflicts. Notably the 2001 ethno-religious crisis in Jos, resulted in significant loss of lives, displacement, and psychosocial trauma. In recent years, Bassa and Jos North Local Government Areas (LGAs) have experienced a resurgence of conflicts, including farmer-herder clashes, kidnapping, and banditry, further aggravating humanitarian, development, social, and security crises. These conflicts have led to the loss of lives, livelihoods, productive assets, and infrastructure, creating an environment of fear and mistrust that has strained relations between neighbors and family members. Traditional conflict resolution mechanisms have proven inadequate in this context of escalating violence, rendering the social fabric of these communities torn apart.
